title: A clinically-aware quantum classifier: triage that knows when to defer
seoDescription: Build a variational quantum classifier for breast-cancer triage that abstains on uncertain cases, is tuned not to miss malignancies, survives quantum noise, and explains itself, benchmarked honestly against classical models.
